nodes.summary: True Ancestors originate from the moon's extreme being Crimson Moon as agents made by the planet's will.
Arcueid naturally appears with specifications far exceeding her peers in response to fallen True Ancestors and Dead Apostles.

nodes.timeRaw: 早期 / 苏醒讨伐、事后沉睡
nodes.summary: She is cultivated as a weapon to execute Demon Lords and Dead Apostles and cycles between waking to subjugate and sleeping afterward.
Roa deceives her into drinking blood; part of her power is taken, Roa becomes her direct Dead Apostle, and rampaging Arcueid kills the True Ancestors in Millennium Castle.
Shiki dismembers her into seventeen pieces; she appears the next day and takes Shiki to her hotel room to avoid Nero Chaos.
Her clothing rapidly changes until it becomes the red Arcueid outfit.
